words.example: We can negotiate the delivery day, but not the safety clauses.
words.exampleZh: 送货日期可以协商，安全条款不行。

words.example: The compromise was a nine-thirty start instead of nine o'clock.
words.exampleZh: 折中的结果是九点半开始，而不是九点。

words.example: There is no consensus yet on whether interns should work nights.
words.exampleZh: 实习生要不要上夜班，目前还没有共识。

words.example: Feedback from the night shift says the handover note is too long.
words.exampleZh: 夜班的反馈是交接说明写得太长。

words.example: Please treat this family complaint as confidential and keep it in the office.
words.exampleZh: 请把这封家属投诉当作保密件，只留在办公室里。

words.example: The card printer ran out of blanks during staff enrollment.
words.exampleZh: 员工办卡时，卡片打印机的空白卡用完了。

words.example: The handheld terminal in pharmacy cannot scan the new drug barcodes.
words.exampleZh: 药房的手持终端扫不了新药的条码。

words.example: This workstation in clinic three keeps losing the network around noon.
words.exampleZh: 门诊三诊室这台工作站一到中午前后就掉线。

words.example: The thin client at bed nine boots, then drops the session.
words.exampleZh: 九床的瘦客户机能开起来，随后会话就断了。

words.example: The fat client on this desk still runs the old order program locally.
words.exampleZh: 这张桌上的胖客户机还在本地跑旧的医嘱程序。
